array_conventions.bits: Indices ascend b0 through b19; raw b0 is rightmost.
array_conventions.conditional: Each conditional is [one-count, conditioning-count]; zero denominator means undefined.
array_conventions.covariance: Numerator divided by stated denominator is the empirical centered product mean.
array_conventions.joint: Rows early label 0,1; columns terminal label 0,1.

comparison.block_pairing_boundary: Equal-index blocks belong to separate jobs rather than paired measurements.

interpretation: Bits are provider-reported thresholded measurement labels, not independently calibrated populations.
The retained API records contain neither IQ samples nor discriminator thresholds.
Joint counts cannot separate assignment, preparation, dynamics and acquisition defects.
Covariances and contiguous blocks are descriptive; no IID, significance or stationarity claim follows.
Signed permutations test only fixed relabeling of the three early bits, not arbitrary packing corruption.
All counts retain the frozen qualification decision; post-hoc relabeling cannot approve acquisition.
